Photographer in the Netherlands

A place.
Your kind of feeling.

Based in the Netherlands, photographing weddings, couples, portraits, maternity, children, families and events throughout the Netherlands.

The location is part of the story. We’ll choose it for the light, the atmosphere and the way you want the session to feel — then agree the practical details and travel before booking.

Enquire about a session ↗︎

Amsterdam

A photoshoot in Amsterdam can be a quiet walk together, a personal portrait or time with your family. Vicon Creator works on location, with cinematic colour and expressive black-and-white photography. Start with the kind of day you want to have, then choose the backdrop.

Plan a session here ↗︎

The Hague / Den Haag

In The Hague, the first choice is often between a city setting and the coast. For a love story, maternity portrait or family photoshoot, that choice changes the walking, clothing and pace. Vicon Creator offers sessions in Den Haag by arrangement, with the same cinematic approach throughout.

Plan a session here ↗︎

Rotterdam

Rotterdam offers a strong visual starting point for an expressive portrait or a city love story. For events, the programme and the people set the direction. Vicon Creator works on location in Rotterdam; a portrait session and an event brief each receive a different plan.

Plan a session here ↗︎

Utrecht

A family photoshoot in Utrecht works best when the route fits the family. A couple session or personal portrait may use the same city in a very different way. Vicon Creator photographs on location across the Netherlands, including Utrecht, with the setting chosen around your story.

Plan a session here ↗︎
